question: Estimate monthly sales of premium liquor (Scotch + premium IMFL >₹2000/bottle) in Goa.
idealClarificationQuestions: Premium imported scotch + premium Indian-made foreign liquor (IMFL)? Yes.
Bars + retail outlets in Goa? Yes — total state sales.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~25% (Goa skews premium because tourism + low taxes).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average premium liquor spend per active premium drinker per month

calculationFlow: Goa permanent population: ~15 lakh adults (legal drinking age).
Plus tourists (Goa has ~80 lakh tourists/year, ~6.5 lakh/month on average; ~80% in 22-50 age drinkers).
Total relevant drinking population (monthly): 15L permanent + 5.2L tourist drinkers = ~20 lakh adults.
Of these, premium liquor consumers (>₹2K bottles): ~25% (Goa skews premium because tourism + low taxes).
Average premium liquor spend per active premium drinker per month: ~₹2,500.
Monthly premium liquor market Goa: 5L × ₹2,500 = ~₹125 Cr.
Tonnage equivalent: ~₹125 Cr / avg ₹3,500/bottle × 0.7L = ~25,000 cases (15-bottle equiv).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Tonnage equivalent: ~₹125 Cr / avg ₹3,500/bottle × 0.7L = ~25,000 cases (15-bottle equiv).
